metadata.description: Official Rewind plugins for Claude — connect Claude to your church's own preaching corpus, with verbatim citations. It never changes sermon content.

plugins.name: rewind
plugins.description: Prep sermons, plan series, build study briefs, and search how your church has already preached a passage or theme — grounded only in your church's sermons, with verbatim citations. The MCP connection cannot create, edit or delete sermon content; it can save source clips you choose to your private history.
